Index.title: Erfan Bensaeed
Index.subtitle: Mechanical Engineer & Computational Simulation Specialist
Index.description: Master's student in Computational Methods in Engineering specializing in CFD, FEM, and DEM. Motivated to precisely model and optimize complex technical problems.

About.heading: About Me
About.text: I am currently pursuing my M.Sc. at Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg. My focus is on applying computational methods like CFD, FEM, and DEM to real-world engineering challenges. I am looking for a working student (Werkstudent) position or a Master's thesis opportunity to apply my theoretical knowledge in an industry setting.

Projects.heading: Featured Engineering Projects
Projects.p1Title: Optimization of a Bulk Material Transfer Chute
Projects.p1Desc1: Reduced impact forces by 67% through DEM simulation and design optimization of the rock-box geometry.
Projects.p1Desc2: Improved mass distribution on the conveyor belt by 70% to eliminate material spillage.
Projects.p2Desc1: Conducted static structural FE analysis to determine optimal clamping positions under wind and snow loads.
Projects.p2Desc2: Successfully reduced maximum deflection and stress concentrations through strategic mount positioning.
